content.short: OnChain Industries is an Open-Source Intelligence (OSINT) tool with a web-based capability.
content.description: OSINT tools have traditionally concentrated on Web2, with platforms designed to discover and enrich profiles and associated accounts. OnChain Industries extends this approach to Web3 by enabling investigators to map connections between an email address, a user name, or a wallet address and corresponding Web3 accounts across more than 73 sites. The solution supports real-time intelligence retrieval through an API, allowing analysts to correlate on-chain activity with identity signals and build comprehensive link analyses for security investigations and fraud detection.
